criteria.name: factual_grounding
criteria.description: Does every claim in the summary trace back to something actually stated in the source, with no invented facts, numbers, or attributions?

criteria.name: coverage
criteria.description: Does the summary include the source's key points, not just the first paragraph or the most quotable line?

criteria.name: conciseness
criteria.description: Is the summary meaningfully shorter than the source while still standing on its own without the source open?
